method: Complete named explanatory fields from the exact subject/pointer. Original summaries, subjects and historical reviews unchanged. This is an excerpt, not a standalone replacement contract or review.

summary.answer: Creates spacer, localized killstreak-ready text and scorestreak icon container. The setText wrapper recalculates parent width after text assignment per CallOriginalFirst helper ordering. Registers close, optional PostLoadFunc and returns self; no readiness producer or scorestreak award is implemented.
unknowns: Exact original PS4/source version matching, recovered Lua/VM fidelity and global/native/LUI provider identity remain unverified.
Model/storage/DDL/assets/localization/dvar/enum values, callback delivery/cancellation/error behavior, native networking and unavailable service/server code are separate inputs.
Other-file locals are not providers by spelling. Exact qualified global declarations are source candidates until loader/table identity and caller conditions bind them.
No implicit nil/type checks, exception recovery, timer/model disposal, idempotence or guarantee that later effects run after an error is added.

summary.answer: Constructs the scorestreak-ready notification and progress ring. ScorestreakInfo width changes scale the parent; non-nil heroHoldProgress updates ring rendering. The ring Visible predicate is AlwaysTrue, controller text distinguishes PC gamepad, and parent states distinguish caster/PC. Exact model/input subscriptions, close and optional PostLoadFunc precede return self. Ability readiness and native event production remain separate contracts.
unknowns: No actual callback delivery, cancellation-after-close, successful native mutation or service response is proved.
Recovered source defects, nil fallthroughs, repeated/replaced registrations and opaque aliases are preserved rather than repaired.
Public-reuse investigation is inherited from frozen archived-record-00026; this author performed no outside research.

summary.answer: Hud_WZ directly constructs ReadyEvents and subscribes it to scriptNotify afterward. Builds ready notification images/text and scorestreak child, then registers state predicates: Hidden for any demo hidden/moviecam/EMP/no HUD or guided missile/killcam/remote streak/opaque bit/vehicle/flash/scoped/play-of-match/scoreboard/UI-active/no weapon-HUD; HiddenHacked requires hudItems.hacked>0; CodcasterHidden requires caster without enabled scorestreak-notification profile. Each relevant visibility/model/profile update reevaluates state. Constructor installs close then optional PostLoadFunc, calls ReadyEventsPostLoad last, returns self. It does not itself receive hero_weapon_received just because the caller registered a notification. Unselected class clips/close/postload helper are exact dependencies; native scriptNotify dispatch and effective HMH visibility remain open.
unknowns: Original Lua-to-PS4 CUSA11100 build binding and bytecode/VM/decompiler fidelity unverified.

Effective HMH settings, enum values, model/data production, LUI state arbitration, event delivery/ordering/cancellation, assets, storage/DDL, networking/service behavior remain explicit gaps where called.
